source_review: UNLV's official play-by-play credits the 1H 3:43 three to Max Majerle.

Green Bay and ESPN agree on the three scorer credits. Cincinnati and Torvik transfer one three from Collins to Colvin. The disputed candidates with both players on court have identical RAPM lineups and points.
The LSU game book identifies Ahmed Nedal Abdelrahman as #7. ESPN lists him as Ahmed Nedal #9.
UC San Diego credits the 2H 8:39 three to Leo Beath and records the 2H 14:48 offensive rebound before substitutions.
The official log also records an 11-second gap between Houston Christian's exit and entry. The possession spanning it is excluded.
Hawai‘i's official box lists Kajus Mikalauskas, who is absent from the Torvik game box. He is included in the replay based on the substitutions.
Hawai‘i's game log records Nance's offensive-foul turnover before the substitutions at 10:21.
The official log records a Georgia Tech defensive rebound and steal at the same stoppage. Excluded the intervening Eastern Kentucky turnover observation because the control sequence is ambiguous.
Utah State's game log records Brown's layup before the substitutions at 18:19 in the second half.
School play-by-play orders Jevtic's layup before the substitutions at 15:54 and Duchamp's entry after the foul at 7:01.
